release_notes:
Updated the interface: new standalone Check button (duplicate/ZBrush/combined-mesh checks no longer slow down every Analyze HP run), redesigned update-check window, renamed Color Groups to Color HP.
Fixed old bugs: a crash in the final HP group merge pass, viewport refresh conflicts between Smooth View and Color HP that could crash Maya, the pre-analysis checker silently stopping after an in-window fix.
Added integrity verification to the auto-updater.
...and, as always, probably added a few new ones :)
